scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/frontend && npm run build -w apps/backend && npm run build -w apps/admin
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w apps/frontend && npm run build -w apps/backend && npm run build -w apps/admin
scripts.dev:full: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/frontend && npm run lint -w apps/admin
scripts.start:prod: npm run build && npm run start:prod -w apps/backend
